name: open-holdem-manager
description: Local poker hand history tracker for GGPoker Rush & Cash

scripts.check: npm run check:electron && npm run check:quit
scripts.backend:build: cd backend && ..\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m PyInstaller --name ohm-backend --onedir --noconfirm --collect-submodules uvicorn --collect-submodules fastapi --collect-submodules starlette --collect-submodules pydantic --collect-submodules duckdb --hidden-import multipart run_server.py
scripts.build: npm run check && npm run clean && npm run frontend:build && npm run backend:build && electron-builder --publish never
